description: Read .flurryport/pipes.json from the working directory: the committed record of the pipes this repo delivers through, holding name, endpoint, recipe, transformation, intent schema, and signing refs, never key material. No inputs. Use it at session start to discover existing pipes, or when the user asks what is wired up. Server state is the source of truth: if they disagree, trust list_endpoints and list_replay_targets.
name: read_pipe_manifest
title: Read pipe manifest
